claim: Downloads a valid Chrome extension ZIP with complete consumer installation instructions.
where: Landing-page install section, packaged INSTALL.txt, and README
sandbox: Fresh browser context; verify the guide, ZIP response, signature, manifest, and packaged INSTALL.txt.

claim: A visitor can try a searchable sample reader in one click without an account or saved demo data.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo/; exercise search and reset, then assert the demo has not written browser storage.

claim: Turns an accessible caption track into readable paragraphs with search and timestamp links.
where: Landing page, extension description, and README
sandbox: Temporary extension profile with a routed YouTube page and recorded json3 caption fixture.

claim: Captures captions available to the visitor on YouTube and TED without downloading video, creating missing captions, or summarising them.
where: Landing page, privacy policy, terms, extension description, and README
sandbox: Temporary extension profile with routed YouTube json3 and a representative current TED visible-transcript DOM fixture.

claim: Transcript capture, reading, search, and storage do not send transcript text to Transcript Tidy.
where: Landing privacy section, privacy policy, and README
sandbox: Temporary extension profile; record the full workflow request log and allow only the routed source page and caption track.

claim: Exports the captured transcript as TXT and HTML in the browser.
sandbox: Temporary extension profile with recorded caption fixture; download and inspect both export files.

claim: Search, type, spacing, timestamp, print, and export controls are available without Plus.
where: Landing page, terms, popup, and README
sandbox: Temporary extension profile with a captured fixture; operate every reader control and intercept print.

claim: The site has no analytics, remote fonts, or third-party runtime scripts, and the extension does not read captions in the background.
sandbox: Fresh site and extension contexts; inspect loaded resources and assert caption requests begin only after explicit capture.

claim: Transcript Tidy Plus is a $12 one-time local shelf for up to 50 recent reads; checkout and license restoration wait for factory billing registration.
where: Landing Plus section, popup, terms, and README
sandbox: Fresh site context confirms the one-time offer and unavailable state without a checkout or token field; deterministic transcript objects prove the local shelf keeps 50 reads.
